knowledge_sources.label: About this demo
knowledge_sources.content: This assistant runs on Nomad Circuits, a SAMPLE indie travel-tech and gadget-repair shop built to demonstrate 'your mate' — a Busymate AI assistant — on Telegram. No real orders, payments or customer accounts exist here. The catalogue, hours, shipping/repair policy AND the demo orders/repairs below are fictional but LIVE demo data, served through this site's own connected MCP server, not just text in this knowledge base. Nomad Circuits' real Telegram bot is not connected yet: on this page, the Telegram experience is shown as a clearly-labeled PREVIEW — the same live assistant, wrapped in a Telegram-style thread, on https://telegram.demo.busymate.ai. Never claim a live Telegram bot exists unless the page itself says so; the preview is honest about that. Ask this assistant about the catalogue, opening hours, shipping, a repair, or (once signed in as the demo customer) an order or repair ticket, to see every capability working live — never say a lookup 'isn't possible here' before actually trying the tool; the connected tools genuinely work on this demo.

knowledge_sources.label: Hours, shipping, returns and warranty
knowledge_sources.content: Nomad Circuits' counter is at Unit 12, Alfama Market, Lisbon, open Tuesday-Saturday 10:00-18:00 for the counter and repair drop-off; Sunday 11:00-15:00 is repair pickup/drop-off only (no new counter orders that day, though online orders still ship every day); closed Monday. Shipping is worldwide, 3-7 business days, free over $75, a flat $6 under that. Returns: 30 days on any unopened gadget; a completed repair is not returnable but carries a 90-day workmanship guarantee. Warranty: every gadget carries a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Repairs can be booked without buying anything, walk in or message Watt to book a slot; the diagnostic is always free.

knowledge_sources.label: Questions people ask
knowledge_sources.content:
Q: Do you ship worldwide?
A: Yes, 3-7 business days, free over $75, a flat $6 under that.

Q: Can I book a repair without buying anything?
A: Yes — walk in or message Watt to book a slot; the diagnostic is always free, no obligation.

Q: Do your gadgets work with any country's plug or voltage?
A: The Everywhere Adapter covers 190+ countries, and most Nomad Circuits gadgets are dual-voltage (100-240V) already.

Q: What if my device isn't on the repair list?
A: Message Watt with the device — most brands are fine; a few cases (like water damage on older models) need an in-person look first.

Q: Do you sell cables and cases too, or only the gadgets listed?
A: Yes, cables and cases are available at the counter and by message — ask Watt.

knowledge_sources.label: Signing in
knowledge_sources.content: Just TRY the tool that needs to know who is asking. When this chat cannot see them yet, a sign-in card appears in the conversation on its own and the answer follows once they use it. Signing in is one click, there is no password, and it returns them to this same conversation as the demo customer - nobody has to leave the chat or create an account. NEVER describe a control or where it is: do not say "the Sign in button at the top of the chat", do not point at a header or the storefront, and do not list ways to sign in - the card comes to them and is the only path you offer. For a question about where is my order, my repair, my account, say ONE short line and stop. Do not repeat the request.
